intent: Create one grounded narrative film frame in which two adult siblings reveal a decision through distance, gaze, and an unfinished object action.

direction.visual_goal: show an irreversible relationship decision without poster-style simultaneous presentation

cinematic.visible_event: the younger sister releases their father's brass compass before her brother reaches it
cinematic.relationship_pressure: the siblings remain far apart and avoid direct eye contact
cinematic.viewer_task: infer that the sister has already decided to leave
cinematic.viewer_position: seated at the far left end of the same weathered bench
cinematic.frozen_moment: the compass has stopped between both hands while the brother's reach remains unfinished
cinematic.withheld_information: the ferry and destination remain offscreen

scene.summary: A closed river ferry terminal before sunrise.
scene.setting: Weathered green bench, concrete columns, railing, empty ramp, cold river haze.

subjects.description: A fictional adult Chinese woman in dark practical travel clothing.
subjects.action: Withdraws her hand after releasing the compass.
subjects.pose: Seated, shoulders still, body angled toward the unseen ramp.
subjects.gaze: Looks frame-right toward the offscreen ferry ramp.
relationships: releases the shared compass before he reaches it

subjects.description: A fictional adult Chinese man in a dark weathered jacket.
subjects.action: Stops his hand short of the compass.
subjects.pose: Seated farther away, weight not yet shifted.
subjects.gaze: Watches his sister's withdrawing hand rather than her face.

staging.primary_relationship: The sister withdraws from her brother across a shared bench.
staging.eyeline_logic: sister looks toward the ramp; brother watches her hand
staging.screen_direction: attention moves left-to-right toward the unseen exit
staging.axis: bench, compass, and eyelines keep the relationship readable
staging.occlusion: foreground railing partially blocks the brother
staging.attention_path: compass to withdrawing hand to brother's gaze to empty frame-right ramp

composition.camera_motivation: place the viewer inside the shared but separating space
composition.camera_distance: close enough to read hands and faces while preserving the empty bench distance
composition.lens_rationale: natural relationship distance without wide-angle facial distortion
composition.subject_frame_ratio: people occupy about half the frame; empty space carries the remaining pressure
composition.framing: siblings separated across the horizontal frame; compass is small and central but not heroic
composition.foreground_logic: railing proves the constrained viewer position
composition.negative_space: empty frame-right space implies the unseen ramp and departure

lighting.summary: Cold predawn ambient light with one weak amber maintenance practical.
lighting.motivation: blue dawn enters from the unseen ramp; an existing lamp glows behind the bench
lighting.narrative_function: the compass receives the clearest small highlight while the destination stays dim
lighting.contrast: uneven but readable faces; ordinary dark areas remain
lighting.color_temperature: cool blue ambient and weak amber practical

materials.description: Weathered painted wood and a small handled brass compass.

color.contrast: medium-low microcontrast with one small bright object

quality_controls: selective focus and ordinary background falloff
